notes: Charts generated programmatically per problem: each is a Chart.js scatter+line (tension 0.35, 6-10 integer points) whose every point satisfies the stated equation exactly (verified in build script). Grid uses theme-neutral grey rgba(128,128,128,0.18); no answer text is printed on the charts, only the curve and x/y axes. Opener gained a self-contained inline SVG (1247 bytes) plotting the projectile height-time table (0m@0s, max 9m@3s, 0m@6s) as a real-life parabola: text/axes use currentColor, points use soft #60a5fa, no external refs. Deliberately NOT decorated: bronze substitution problems 0,1,4,6,7 (pure calculation, spec says leave textual); bronze[5] (direction-from-equation, drawing it would reveal the answer and an exam would not print it); gold[1] (unknown b: no faithful curve possible); gold[3] (find c: only roots given, drawing would reveal the answer). No question text, solutions, guided steps, hints or misconceptions were changed.
